notes:
kr8 0.4.10: This update adds a read-only panel that shows what a running agent was actually started with (on by default), lets a tile you add to Home land in its own spot, previews a circle with the Ellipse tool, shows names instead of bare keys in the chat dock, keeps an agent's unplaced Canvas nodes off the Home bands, and stops Windows notifications from being shown as denied when they are not. It also carries the first set of R2 building blocks, nearly all of them off by default: turn timings, profile-scoped knowledge proposals, skill withdrawal, outside agents pairing with the canvas, a core-memory status line, a durable relay outbox, a canvas write guard, measured agent concurrency, and live boards on their own event kind.
